title: The proposed lines panel is the same one as the Line Builder's
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - Create & Edit', on the build under test; ShopCoach is enabled and the shop has at least one labor type.
  2. Both entry points reachable: the inspection build flow, and the work-order-started Line Builder. An inspection with two findings whose titles match.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm the proposed-lines panel is the same one the work-order Line Builder uses, and a change made for this flow lands on that one too without degrading it.
2. In the inspection flow, confirm two findings with matching titles are not collapsed into one line — the panel compares by finding identifier while serving this flow.
3. Confirm the work-order Line Builder keeps its existing comparison (it has no findings), i.e. the panel is told which flow it is in rather than having its behaviour changed for both.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The proposed-lines panel is shared with the Line Builder started from a work order with no inspection; a change made for this flow lands on that one too and must not degrade it.
  • Two findings are never collapsed into one proposed line because their titles match: while serving this flow the panel compares proposed lines by their finding identifier, while the work-order Line Builder keeps its existing comparison.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9404 (S15 — Draft the lines with ShopCoach); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S15; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S15-R16: “The proposed-lines panel is shared with the Line Builder that is started from a work order with no inspection. A change made for this flow lands on that one too, and must not degrade it”
  • S15-R24: “Two findings will never be collapsed into one proposed line because their titles match. The panel compares proposed lines by their finding identifier while it is serving this flow, and keeps its existing comparison for the Line Builder started from a work order, which has no findings and relies on it. The shared panel is told which flow it is in rather than having its behaviour changed for both (S15-R16)”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
